rationale: Use own colour and nearest nonzero colours in the four directions. In demonstration 1, the changed zero at row 1, column 3 has directional colours (absent,3,absent,2) and becomes 2. In demonstration 5, row 5, column 2 has (3,absent,absent,1) and becomes 9. Other demonstrated directional keys preserve their colours.

Use own colour and zero-based row and column residues modulo 3. Zeros become 3 at residues (0,2), (2,1), and (2,2), and become 8 at (1,1). Demonstration 1 shows all four changes; subsequent demonstrations repeat them at positions offset by three rows or columns. Other keys preserve their colours.
